title: Netcompany's business model is bespoke build and it owns the client relationship
content:
Netcompany's business model is bespoke build and it owns the client relationship, and the research reads that combination as making it the closest competitor rather than a channel. It was previously ranked first in Denmark.

The distinction turns on who holds the client. Most leads in this set deliver into relationships a platform can sit inside; Netcompany's model is to own both the build and the relationship, so anything it adopted would be adopted as its own capability rather than resold onward. At 7,800+ people it is also well past the size at which a first partner is workable.

The corroborating detail sits elsewhere in this corpus: Netcompany is the buyer that acquired SDC, the member-bank-owned Danish cooperative. It is consolidating the same Nordic market this lead set is trying to enter.
